## One place to manage every part of your infrastructure pipeline

Ditch patchwork pipelines that slow devs and platform teams and leave security in the dark

![warning meter icon](https://spacelift.io/_next/image?url=https%3A%2F%2Fspacelift.io%2Fwp-content%2Fuploads%2F2026%2F03%2Fwarning-icon.png&w=96&q=75)

### Provision and configure in one workflow

- Standardize how Terraform, OpenTofu, CloudFormation, Pulumi, Kubernetes, and Ansible run
- Model environments with stacks and dependencies, not one giant pipeline
- Trigger configuration automatically after infrastructure changes

![gear icon](https://spacelift.io/_next/image?url=https%3A%2F%2Fspacelift.io%2Fwp-content%2Fuploads%2F2026%2F03%2Fgear-icon.png&w=96&q=75)

### Automate everything that happens after deployment

- See every Day 2 automation, with a full audit trail
- Build production-grade automations in an afternoon, not a sprint
- Connect agents safely through MCP servers you control

![security icon](https://spacelift.io/_next/image?url=https%3A%2F%2Fspacelift.io%2Fwp-content%2Fuploads%2F2026%2F03%2Fsecurity-icon.png&w=96&q=75)

### Implement guardrails that keep you fast

- Use OPA-based policies for plans, approvals, and notifications
- Delegate safely with Spaces, Contexts, and RBAC
- Get real-time visibility into every run and every automation, and who’s behind it
- See and remediate drift before it becomes an incident

![Guardrails that keep you fast](https://spacelift.io/_next/image?url=https%3A%2F%2Fspacelift.io%2Fwp-content%2Fuploads%2F2026%2F07%2FGuardrails-that-keep-you-fast.png&w=828&q=75)

## A modern approach to infrastructure management

The Spacelift Orchestration Platform brings governed IaC and GitOps deployment together with Day 2 operations and an Infrastructure Assistant, so you can keep pace.

![Spacelift platform diagram](https://spacelift.io/wp-content/uploads/2026/10/Platform-diagram.png)

## Why platform teams choose Spacelift

Spacelift understands your stacks, dependencies, state, and resources, giving you one place to manage every part of your infrastructure pipeline.

![Traditional CI-CD doesn't work for infrastructure](https://spacelift.io/_next/image?url=https%3A%2F%2Fspacelift.io%2Fwp-content%2Fuploads%2F2026%2F03%2Ftraditional-ci-cd.png&w=1080&q=75)

### Traditional CI/CD doesn't work for infrastructure

- First-class support for Terraform, OpenTofu, CloudFormation, Pulumi, Kubernetes
- Native resource view and drift detection
- Workflows that understand state, not hacked-together jobs and scripts

[Learn more about infrastructure orchestration](https://spacelift.io/ci-cd-for-infrastructure)

![Fast self-service for developers](https://spacelift.io/_next/image?url=https%3A%2F%2Fspacelift.io%2Fwp-content%2Fuploads%2F2026%2F03%2Fself-service.png&w=1080&q=75)

- Multi-IaC orchestration beyond Terraform-only workflows
- Consistent policies and visibility across every environment
- Predictable pricing, not tied to resources under management
- One control plane for deployment and Day 2 operations.

[Learn more](https://spacelift.io/terraform-enterprise-alternative)

## How Spacelift fits into your world

Choose your flavor of Spacelift

Choose between fully managed SaaS, self-hosted in any cloud, on-premises, or FedRAMP-authorized SaaS.

Connect your clouds

Plug in your IaC and configuration code, link your cloud accounts, and set up dynamic credentials.

Integrate Provisioning and Day 2 Ops

Provision and configure with Spacelift Deploy. Automate everything that happens after with Spacelift Flows.

Create your policies

Define OPA-based policies for plans, approvals, notifications, and security controls, in natural language or as code.

Enable self-service

Write your own deployment templates and Day 2 automations, or describe what you need to the Spacelift AI assistant.

Monitor, adjust, and improve

Chat with your AI assistant to view resources, detect drift, run automations, and make changes, so you keep pace with modern development.
